records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 20 November 2026.

[2026-11-20_XLM]  
Video Title: Stellar Drops 32% to $0.13: Can XLM Hold Risk Level 2 & Target $0.75–$1.00?  
Video ID: IR-LmuA1fcY  
Stellar (XLM) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure:  
    • XLM is trading at 13 cents, down 32% over the last 90 days.  
    • The 20‑WE simple moving average sits above the price, with the asset currently at risk level 16 on the SMA model, indicating a high‑risk, pullback zone.  
    • Composite risk scores place XLM near the lower edge of the deep‑accumulation zone, with a gravity risk of 15/100 and a market‑cap‑adjusted risk level of 2.  
    • Social‑sentiment wordclouds show a surge of negative terms (“panic”, “sell”, “bear”) and a muted bullish voice, reflecting low investor confidence.  

    Macro Quantitative Risk:  
    • The time‑weighted average price (TWAP) baseline is 19 cents; XLM is currently 30% undervalued relative to TWAP.  
    • Regression‑based fair value sits at 25 cents, a 50% deviation from the current price, placing the asset in a deep capitulation phase.  
    • The 90‑day ROI and move‑consistency metrics confirm a below‑median momentum profile, while the logarithmic market‑cap scaling flags XLM as a low‑risk, high‑volume asset.  
    • Residual zones show XLM is 47% undervalued against lifetime TWAP, with a historical tendency to trade 30% below fair value during mid‑cycle periods.  

    Downside & Upside Targets:  
    • The estimated bear‑market floor is 2 cents, with a panic floor at the same level, indicating a hard support at the lower end of the price spectrum.  
    • The 10‑week case projects a near‑term floor of 9 cents, while the bull case, based on phase‑detection models, targets 22 cents in the short term.  
    • Long‑term cycle bull targets place the maximum euphoria level at 75 cents, with a stretch goal of $1.00 for an extended rally.  
    • Machine‑learning forecasts suggest a 99.7% confidence that XLM will remain below the 25‑cent fair‑value band until the next accumulation phase, reinforcing the need for cautious positioning.

Video Title: Stellar XLM Accumulation Zones: Finding the Support Levels Before the Rally  
Video ID: 2YgnVERRKEw  
Stellar (XLM) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure:  
    • Current weekly price sits at 18¢, just above the 20‑week SMA of roughly 18¢, indicating a marginally bullish stance.  
    • Composite risk score is 25, placing XLM in risk level 3 (20–30 range) and confirming its status in a bear‑market accumulation phase.  
    • Social sentiment remains low, with minimal narrative coverage, yet the overall risk model ranks XLM as the lowest‑risk breakout crypto at this time.  

    Macro Quantitative Risk:  
    • Time‑Weighted Average Price (TWAP) baseline hovers near 19¢, with the current premium at a modest +3% and a lifetime average of 19¢.  
    • Polynomial regression fair‑value band places XLM’s intrinsic value at 25¢, with a bottom regression of 13¢ and a peak of 17¢, underscoring a clear undervaluation relative to the market.  
    • Risk levels oscillate between 20–30, and the gravity risk metric sits at 24, slightly lower than peers but higher than Bitcoin or ETH.  

    Downside & Upside Targets:  
    • Machine‑learning forecasts set a 10‑week bare case at 13¢ and a boom case at 31¢, with a base projection near 20¢.  
    • Short‑term rally potential could lift XLM to 27–28¢ over the next 3–4 weeks, while a pullback would find support near the 20‑week SMA of 18¢.  
    • Cycle‑based bull target aligns with a 60% completion of the 4‑year cycle, suggesting a long‑term upside that could approach the Bitcoin peak forecast of $1–$143 (historical range).
